# Git Worktree and Stack Workflow

Read [`WORKTREES.md`](../../../WORKTREES.md) before creating worktrees,
switching tasks, or using `gh stack`. That file is the source of truth for
branch isolation, stack synchronization, readiness checks, merge order, and
cleanup. Keep this skill as a pointer so rules do not drift between providers.
